title: Who should know

conversations.title: Who should know about the BOK-412 fix

claims.claim: The fix for BOK-412 has been live since this morning, 2026-07-17: one reminder per booking, whatever the source.
Sjögatan reported the double reminder on 2026-06-24 and was told we are looking into it, with no date.
Pizzeria Napoli reported the double reminder on 2026-06-26 and was told we are looking into it, with no date.
Jonas has four open support tickets on the double reminder and a macro that still says we are looking into it.

text: Three people have waited for this. [[people/ulrika-nystrom]] and [[people/petra-alm]]: their restaurants asked in June and got no date. [[people/jonas-berg]]: four open tickets and a macro that still says we are looking into it.
[[customers/kaffekopp]] churned in 2025. Not hearing that a fix had shipped was a reason they gave.

variants.label: Short
variants.body:
Hey Ulrika and Petra,

The double reminder is fixed. Since this morning, guests who book through Google get one reminder text, the day before at 17:00.

Sjögatan reported it on 2026-06-24 and Pizzeria Napoli on 2026-06-26. Both have had "we are looking into it" since, so you hear it before they do, and they should hear it from you today.

Here is a note you can forward as it is:

> Hi,
>
> You told us that guests who book through Google got the reminder text twice. That is fixed since this morning: guests now get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. Sorry for the noise.

variants.label: With what to tell guests
variants.body:
Hey Ulrika and Petra,

The double reminder is fixed. Since this morning, guests who book through Google get one reminder text, the day before at 17:00.

Sjögatan reported it on 2026-06-24 and Pizzeria Napoli on 2026-06-26. Both have had "we are looking into it" since, so you hear it before they do, and they should hear it from you today.

Here is a note you can forward as it is:

> Hi,
>
> You told us that guests who book through Google got the reminder text twice. That is fixed since this morning: guests now get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. We are sorry for the noise.
>
> If a guest still asks whether their booking is right, the answer is yes: one text means one booking. If a guest gets two texts for a booking made after this morning, send us the booking and we will look at it.

variants.label: Short
variants.body:
Hey Jonas,

The double reminder is fixed. The fix went out this morning: guests who book through Google now get one reminder, the day before at 17:00.

You asked on 2026-07-06 for a sentence you are allowed to send, and you did not get one. Sorry it took this long. Here is a reply that closes the four tickets:

> Fixed this morning. Guests who book through Google now get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. Sorry for the delay and for the noise. If a booking made after today gets two texts, reply here and we will look at it.

variants.label: With the new macro
variants.body:
Hey Jonas,

The double reminder is fixed. The fix went out this morning: guests who book through Google now get one reminder, the day before at 17:00.

You asked on 2026-07-06 for a sentence you are allowed to send, and you did not get one. Sorry it took this long. Here is a reply that closes the four tickets:

> Fixed this morning. Guests who book through Google now get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. Sorry for the delay and for the noise. If a booking made after today gets two texts, reply here and we will look at it.

And a replacement for the macro that says "we are looking into it":

> Fixed on 2026-07-17: guests who book through Google get one reminder, the day before at 17:00. If a booking made after that date gets two texts, send us the booking.
